title: 有成报销 MCP 对接配置
description: 连接您的有成报销，用于查询本人的报销单、审批进度、费用标准、未报销的消费和发票。API Key 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Connect your YCBX account to query your own expense reports, approval progress, cost standards, unreimbursed expenses and invoices. Your API Key is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only.

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 在有成报销 App 打开 AI 助手 → 右上角「⋯」→ 连接外部 AI 助手 → WorkBuddy 生成
fields.placeholder_en: In the YCBX app, open the AI assistant → ⋯ → Connect external AI assistants → WorkBuddy
fields.description: 员工本人的身份密钥，以 X-Api-Key 请求头发送给有成报销 MCP 服务。只能查询你自己的数据；不用时可在同一位置停用或重新生成。
fields.description_en: Your personal key, sent as the X-Api-Key header to the YCBX MCP service. It only grants access to your own data; you can revoke or regenerate it in the same place.
